title: Hazard Renewal Share After a Replacement Policy or Under Installment Billing
content:
How much of the coming twelve months a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts expects to fall in the renewed hazard term depends on the hazard bills of the review: the hazard insurance bills on file for the reserve received no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

**Replacement month basis.** Where at least one of the hazard bills of the review is withdrawn, the hazard renewal share is the whole calendar months from the due date of the latest paid hazard insurance bill to the review date, divided by twelve, never below zero and never above one — because a replacement policy renews on the anniversary of its own start.

**Installment count basis.** Where none is withdrawn and two or more of the hazard bills of the review are paid or received, the hazard renewal share is the number of paid hazard bills of the review divided by the number of paid and received hazard bills of the review.

**Other files.** This rule does not set the share.

*Hypothetical:* a withdrawn bill in the review and a latest paid hazard bill that fell due 3 whole months before the review give a share of 3 twelfths, one quarter. No withdrawn bill, four bills paid or received of which three are paid: three quarters.
